reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM. Moss's notes give two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

1. #PD-4492 is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. It was logged 4 Oct 2025 and fixed by 5 Oct.
2. #4419 is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It was escalated to tier-2 support. The note has no date, so I couldn't say when it was logged.

I also told her what I left out and why:
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in a Moss note, but they belong to the Marrow accounts on the Central team, not QFL.
- Two other Moss notes mention QFL but give no ticket numbers.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only used public files Moss wrote and channels Dana is a member of. Neither of the tickets is in those channels, and nothing in the reply needed approval.
